colfin22.notes:
Just a heads up for anyone staging 2026.8.3 in Update Manager. This release changes the default map card tiles and now shows a repeated "API KEY REQUIRED" watermark over the map. Nothing is broken, entities and tracking still work, it is just the map background.

It is a Home Assistant frontend issue, not something wrong with your setup. Tracked upstream here if anyone wants to follow it: https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/issues/53800

Wanted to flag it here in case others hold off or want to know why the map looks different after this update.
